levels.surface: عبد الله بن عمرو بن العاص

notes: «فقلت له بلغني أنك حدثت» : Uqba is asked and answers («قال أقط ... قلت نعم»), then relays the saying: he is a link; the report he heard by rumour is not an unnamed gap here because the speaker is named
«قال أقط» and «قال فإذا قال ذلك» are Uqba's speech and the Prophet's words inside his report
